punchline: Five years of work hung on one sentence missing from a lease.
thirty_sec: Sam Walton built his Newport Ben Franklin store into the best in its region. The lease had no renewal clause; the landlord declined to renew and gave the store to his son.
question: Which agreement you work under has no written answer for how it ends?
key_contrast: Success can tempt whoever holds the terms more than it protects you.
